description: This file defines the DashboardScreen widget for a Flutter application, providing a tabbed navigation interface to switch between Patients, Doctors, Consultations, and Medical Records screens. It manages tab state, handles user logout, and composes UI components such as AppBar, TabBar, and TabBarView.

classes.name: DashboardScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that provides the main dashboard interface with tab navigation.

classes.name: _DashboardScreenState
classes.description: State class managing tab controller, lifecycle, and widget building for DashboardScreen.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for DashboardScreen.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the TabController for tab management.

methods.name: _logout
methods.description: Handles user logout by calling AuthProvider and navigating back to login.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree including AppBar, TabBar, and TabBarView.
